text:
Type: plain flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, coastal
Materials: tight flat weave with a fine basket texture, synthetic fiber
Colors: light warm beige, sand, cream flecks
Shape: large plain rectangle with a small woven grid texture, thin flat profile, quiet solid surface
Feel: calm, natural, understated
Goes with: light wood, white furniture, rattan and linen, green plants; Scandinavian, coastal or Japandi rooms

product.name: MORUM
product.description: Ideal in your living room or under your dining table since the flat-woven surface makes it easy to pull out the chairs and vacuum.
